profile.summary:

DirectShow SDK
Assembly language -- MMX, SIMD, and 3DNow

Android XR

positions.title: Senior software manager
positions.description:
Team leader: After graduation, I joined Corel as a senior software manager in Aug. 2008. My role is acting as a key technical RD manager and leading 26 engineers. RD engineers are divided into four teams; namely, (1)Video Decoding System (2)Advance Video Codec (3)Video
Display Render (4)Video Encoding System. We provide new CODEC, components, new product development, and OEM support to our customers for two major products: WinDVD and Corel Video Studio (CVS). WinDVD is a software DVD, Blu-Ray DVD (BD), and AVCHD player while CVS is a video editing tool which can also generate DVD, BD, and AVCHD titles.

– Technical contact window: I am the technical contact window to the following three third party
companies: Intel, AMD, and NVidia. I and our third party coworkers discuss the following topics
weekly or bi-weekly (1) OEM issues of shipping products (2) Utilization of GPU computing
power (such as NVidia CUDA) or multi-core CPU (such as Intel I7) for video encoding and
processing.
